gate: G5 — The world is alive (bible v2 §21)
status: PRE-REGISTERED — committed before any results run. Results that follow a protocol change require a new registration entry; the old entry is never edited.
claim: The living core's opinion trajectory validates against historical opinion time-series; a real injected event yields a simulated reaction matching the measured one; demography matches UN-derived census projections.
on_failure: Fix the physics or narrow the domain — never let the LLM decide (bible v2 §7 risk table).

temporal.protocol: Calibrate per-question force weights on WVS Wave 6 country targets only (Wave 7 never touched during calibration — held out in time). Snapshot t0 force means. Evolve the living world through the W6->W7 interval (default 7 years, 30-day steps) with all endogenous mechanisms on (feedback, coupling, thresholds, rewiring, generational replacement) and zero hand-authored cohort drift; receiver off (no historical signal replay in v1). Re-predict per country at t1 with the SAME weights, feature-centered on the t0 means anchor so global secular drift is not silently subtracted. Score predicted deltas against observed W7-W6 deltas.
temporal.dataset: earth1/wvs_paired.py — 15 questions, WVS Wave 6 (2010-2014) vs Wave 7 (2017-2022), compiled from published aggregates.

metrics.mae_engine: mean |predicted_delta - observed_delta| over all (question, country) pairs
metrics.sign_accuracy: fraction of pairs with |observed_delta| >= 0.02 where sign(predicted) == sign(observed)
metrics.sign_p: one-sided binomial p-value of sign_accuracy against 0.5

temporal.pass: mae_engine < mae_nochange AND sign_accuracy > 0.5 with sign_p < 0.05
caveats: The genesis manifold is calibrated on ~2020-era sources, closer to Wave 7 than Wave 6; this tests whether endogenous dynamics move deltas in the observed direction, not full historical reconstruction.
WVS paired values are compiled from published aggregates and marked verify-against-official-database in the source file.

event_reaction.protocol: Encode a documented real event with its measured before/after poll values. Calibrate the case question's weights on the PRE-event country values only. Inject the event as force-delta WorldEvents scoped to the affected countries, tick the world through the measured reaction window, and compare the simulated shift to the measured shift.
event_reaction.case: COVID-19 onset rally-round-the-flag: trust in national government, Eurobarometer Standard EB 92 (autumn 2019) vs EB 93 (summer 2020), EU country toplines. Measured EU-average shift approximately +6pp. Injected as a FEAR + COLLECTIVE force shock scoped to the encoded EU countries, 90-day window, decay half-life 45 days.

metrics.sign_match: sign(simulated mean shift) == sign(measured mean shift)
metrics.magnitude_ratio: simulated mean shift / measured mean shift

caveats: EB country values compiled from published toplines; verify against GESIS archive.

Shock force-deltas are authored (magnitude chosen a priori at 0.15 fear / 0.10 collective, gain not tuned to the answer); the test is whether the ENGINE's propagation of an authored shock matches measured reality in sign and order of magnitude.

demography.protocol: Run the generational tick alone (no opinion dynamics) for 5 simulated years at 30-day steps on a fresh genesis population. Record every death with its country and age.

metrics.le_tracking: fraction of countries with >= 20 recorded deaths whose mean age at death is within +/- 6 years of the census life expectancy (GENESIS_COUNTRIES 'le', UN-derived)
metrics.world_adult_cdr: annualized deaths per 1000 agents across the whole (18+ only) population

caveats: The population is adults-only (18+) with fixed-N slot replacement, so births == deaths by construction and infant mortality is out of scope; the band [6,15] reflects adult-only crude death rates, wider than the UN all-ages world CDR (~8).

amendments.what: RATE NORMALIZATION, registered before fit_secular.py exists. The functional form is drift = beta_q . D_rate, where D_rate = D / years_i * YEARS_REF — each country's development-change vector divided by ITS OWN fieldwork interval length in years, rescaled to YEARS_REF = 7.0 (the nominal wave gap). Predictions for W6->W7 multiply by the target country's own interval: predicted_drift_i = (beta_q . D_rate_i(W6->W7)) * years_i(W6->W7) / YEARS_REF.
amendments.rationale: A6's fieldwork-year alignment makes intervals genuinely vary (5-year vs 12-year countries), and interval length is NOT random — it correlates with which countries fielded late. Unnormalized beta . D would let the ridge learn interval duration as a confound. Because this changes the functional form, append-only discipline requires it in the registration, not in the fit script.
amendments.unchanged: Everything else in A6: sign constraints, W5->W6-only fitting, frozen betas, LOO-country scoring, shuffled-development placebo, contaminated-sign declaration.

amendments.what: The temporal leg's PASS criteria were to apply to an EVENT-RESPONSIVE question subset produced by a blind partition: one Haiku call per question, temperature 0, question TEXT ONLY (no run results, no country data, no deltas), prompt and partition committed in data/temporal_partition.json BEFORE run #8. Binding rule accepted at design time: the blind partition WINS over the inspected 2026-08-16 screen if they disagree — no manual overrides, no prompt re-shopping.
amendments.outcome_at_registration: The blind partition classified ALL 15 questions SECULAR (0 EVENT). The event subset is therefore EMPTY and the narrowed gate is vacuous BY THE PROCEDURE'S OWN VERDICT. Interpretation registered here: the event-vs-secular regime boundary is a TIMESCALE boundary, not a question-subset boundary — quarter-scale reactions are the event regime (validated by the event_reaction leg, run #7, ratio 1.01); decade-scale WVS deltas are the secular regime entirely, and become the sole registered target of the secular leg (A6). Run #8 (A4) still executes when its data lands, recorded as a confirmation run; its aggregate result is expected to fail for the now-understood reason.
amendments.contamination_note: The screening events were curated with outcome knowledge and per-question W6->W7 results were inspected before this registration. The partition procedure is blind by construction but was DESIGNED after the diagnosis. The 15/15 SECULAR outcome is the anti-favorable case — the procedure prevented carving a favorable subset, which is evidence the blindness is real.
amendments.on_failure: No further partitioning of the WVS temporal set is permitted under any prompt variation; the decade-scale temporal claim lives or dies with A6.

amendments.what: NEW LEG. Claim: decade-scale value change on the WVS paired questions (ALL 15, per A5's blind partition) is predictable from national development trajectories (Inglehart modernization: development shifts societies toward secular-rational and self-expression values). Mechanism: per country, a development-change vector D over the wave interval — delta log(GDP per capita PPP), delta tertiary enrollment (pp), delta urban share (pp), from data/wdi_tide.json, ALIGNED TO PER-COUNTRY WVS FIELDWORK YEARS where published (nominal wave midpoints otherwise; the alignment table is committed with the fit). Per question q, predicted drift = beta_q . D with SIGN-CONSTRAINED ridge: the Inglehart direction (development up -> traditional-religious down, self-expression up) is imposed per question as a constraint, only magnitudes are fit — the same claim shape as RESPONSE_GAIN. Betas fit on W5->W6 observed deltas ONLY, then frozen to data/secular_betas.json. Scored on W6->W7 (betas never touch W7). The secular drift term composes ADDITIVELY with the A4 event term for full-world readouts. Placebo: shuffled-development control (country D vectors permuted, same frozen betas).

metrics.primary: MAE vs no-change on W6->W7 deltas, LOO-country
metrics.secondary_contaminated: sign accuracy — REPORTED but flagged CONTAMINATED: per-question W6->W7 directions were inspected 2026-08-16 before this registration and cannot count as blind evidence.

amendments.blind_validation_path: Genuinely blind confirmation deferred to structure never inspected: (a) WVS Wave 8 deltas when published, and/or (b) EVS 2017 cross-check countries outside the inspected W6->W7 set — both scoreable under the same frozen betas without re-registration.
amendments.data_dependency: WVS Wave 5 (2005-2009) published aggregates for the 15 questions, compiled into earth1/wvs_paired.py with the same verify-against-official-database caveat as W6/W7.
amendments.rationale: The 2026-08-16 screen isolated the failing regime; A5's blind partition then classified the ENTIRE decade-scale set as that regime. Modernization theory supplies the functional form (imposed, not searched); W5->W6 supplies a fitting interval disjoint in time from scoring. Contamination is at the sign level of W6->W7 only; magnitudes and LOO-country structure were never inspected.
amendments.on_failure: If the secular leg fails, G5 records: event regime validated (run #7), demography validated, decade-scale drift honestly open. No fallback fitting on W7 under any registration.

amendments.what: The temporal leg replaces GDELT tone/volume replay (A2, which FAILED its placebo control in run #6) with PERCEIVED-HEADLINE replay: real historical headlines (GDELT DOC artlist, top 3 per country per quarter 2017-2022, cached in data/headlines_2017_2022.json) are perceived by one-call-per-item LLM perception (Haiku, cached in data/perceived_headlines.json) into force events scoped to the headline's country. At prediction time, active event-log deltas route through the TEMPORAL RESPONSE LAW (d_logit = RESPONSE_GAIN x (event_deltas . question_response_profile)) using LLM-authored signed response profiles per question (data/question_profiles.json, authored blind to outcomes). RESPONSE_GAIN = 3.1 unchanged from A3. Three conditions run with identical seeds: endogenous (no events), real geography (perceived headlines on correct countries), shuffled geography (same perceived events, country scopes permuted). Evolution window = the headline range (~6y). PASS: real MAE < no-change AND real MAE < shuffled MAE AND real sign accuracy > 0.5 at p < 0.05.
amendments.rationale: Run #6 proved GDELT tone statistics carry no value-change signal (real = shuffled to 4 decimals). Run #7 proved the response law reproduces measured event reactions (ratio 1.01). The gap is between STATISTICS (no signal) and HAND-AUTHORED shocks (proven signal): can LLM-perceived headlines from real history carry enough semantic information to drive the temporal leg? Perception was validated independently: Italy lockdown perception converged on the hand-authored COVID rally signature; 10/12 historical reaction directions predicted correctly out-of-sample.
amendments.unchanged: Calibration remains Wave-6-only; W7 held out. The endogenous condition is recorded for reference. Shuffled-geography control is identical in structure to A2. PASS criteria identical to A2.

amendments.what: The event leg runs under the TEMPORAL RESPONSE LAW: d_logit = RESPONSE_GAIN x (perceived_shock . question_response_profile). Perceived shocks are LLM-authored from documented headlines (cached in data/perceived_cases.json, authored blind to outcomes); the question's signed response profile is LLM-authored from question text alone (data/question_profiles.json, blind to outcomes); RESPONSE_GAIN = 3.1 is the leave-COVID-out fit over the other five reaction cases — the tested case never touched the constant. Events propagate through the engine (event log, ticks, decay) exactly as in the original protocol; measurement uses the anchored predictor with the response path. PASS criteria unchanged from the original registration: sign match AND magnitude ratio in [0.25, 4.0].
amendments.rationale: Run #6 and the perceived-shock test isolated the failure to the shock->opinion transduction: cross-sectional weights carry the wrong (even opposite) signs for temporal response — COVID fear RAISED trust while fearful societies trust less. The response law was validated out-of-sample at case level (10/12 signs, parameter-free; LOO gain stable 2.0-3.1) before this registration.
amendments.unchanged: Measured EB92->93 values, 90-day window, per-country event injection, decay machinery, pass thresholds.

amendments.what: The temporal leg gains exogenous historical forcing: GDELT monthly tone/volume timelines (2017-2022, fetched once from the DOC 2.0 API, cached in data/gdelt_history.json) are replayed through the SAME adapter force-mapping and gain path the live receiver uses, with Welford baselines warmed on a full-period climatology pass. Evolution window shrinks to the replay window (~6y, the API's historical floor is Jan 2017). Three conditions run with identical seeds: endogenous (A1-era reference), real geography, and shuffled geography (country labels permuted — the inline §14 placebo control). PASS: real beats no-change on MAE AND real beats shuffled on MAE AND real sign accuracy > 0.5 at p < 0.05.
amendments.rationale: Runs #3-#5 established the physics arc: 63.7% sign accuracy on the broken v1 pyramid, 39.7% on cohort entry without trait aging, 44.3% (~parity) on correct stationary physics. Endogenous dynamics alone cannot track history — secular drift requires exogenous signal, exactly as the §14 grounding stack intends. The shuffled-geography control ensures a pass cannot come from global-average forcing alone: the signal must carry country-specific information.
amendments.unchanged: Calibration remains Wave-6-only; W7 stays held out. The A1-era endogenous criterion remains recorded per run for reference but no longer gates.

amendments.what: The le_tracking metric changes from period mean-age-at-death vs LE to a cohort simulation: per distinct census LE value, a synthetic cohort is stepped from age 18 through the SAME hazard code path and dt-scaling the generational tick uses, until extinction; the cohort's mean age at death must be within +/- 6 years of census LE for >= 90% of LE values. Rationale: run #2 exposed (a) a genuine physics bug — the Gompertz calibration pinned the MODAL age at death to LE, leaving mid-life hazard several times life-table rates (fixed in earth1/generational.py, commit follows this amendment); and (b) a metric design error — period mean-age-at-death in a young standing population sits far below cohort LE even under correct physics, so the registered metric could not pass regardless. The cohort metric tests the implementation (dt scaling, age encoding, clipping), not the analytic calibration, and is not satisfiable by construction: bugs in the tick path fail it.
amendments.unchanged: The world_adult_cdr band [6,15] stays as registered — it is an external anchor (UN-derived adult mortality). Run #2 plus the hazard fix shows it will fail for a now-diagnosed reason: the genesis age structure under-represents the elderly (all-ages census median used as adult mean, thin-tailed normal). That failure is the leg doing its job; fixing genesis age sampling alters the frozen manifold and is a founder decision, not a harness tweak.
